rules.statement: A broker is entitled to commission on a sale which he negotiated if the relation of buyer and seller was really caused and brought about by what the broker did.
rules.supporting_quote: "The 'question whether the agent is entitled to be paid commission' on the sale has been often litigated, and the rule has been to 'hold that there has been a sale by an agent, which would entitle him to such commission if the relation of buyer and seller has been really caused and brought about by what he has done, if in other words he was the causa causans by which the property was sold.'"
